messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Integer-grid lattice search with post-hoc continuous relaxation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration achieving the maximum minimum triangle area is obtained by placing points on the 8x8 integer lattice at the coordinates (0,0), (8,0), (0,8), (8,8), (4,1), (4,7), (1,4), (7,4), (3,3), (5,5), (2,6), (6,2), and (4,4) (scaled to the unit square), yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/64; no continuous relaxation of these coordinates can strictly improve this value, as the lattice configuration already saturates the lower bound imposed by the area-based packing argument for 13 points in the unit square."}
